summary: Non-reporting of seizure to Magistrate under Section 102(3) CrPC; issue: mandatory vs directory obligation; delay in seizure reporting does not vitiate seizure; High Court error in de-freezing accounts based on procedural lapse; legislative history from 1882 to 2023 Codes; 1978 amendment context; irregularity not invalidating seizure; impugned order set aside.
legal_provisions_cited: Anwar Ahmad v State of UP AIR 1976 SC 680
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court order de-freezing accounts set aside; seizure validated despite delayed Magistrate reporting.
